verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's marketing docs claim automated identity and access termination across the lifecycle, plus automatic offboarding workflows. They also say HRIS-driven removal of departed employees needs minimal manual intervention. Nothing in the pack describes session revocation on deactivation, SCIM deprovisioning to connected apps, or immediacy for offboarding; the 'revoked instantly' claim refers only to conditional-access triggers. Missing for 10: explicit SCIM/app deprovisioning on user deactivation, session termination on deactivation, evidence of immediate propagation, in-depth docs and independent or hands-on corroboration.
